name: B10-0035/2024 (S&D) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament says it does not accept the July 2024 presidential election in Venezuela as legitimate, because the results were not published or checked. It asks Venezuela's election officials to release full, detailed results. It calls for the release of all political prisoners and an end to repression of opponents, activists and civil society. It also asks the European Union to keep sanctions ready and to support the International Criminal Court's investigations.

- The Parliament rejects the election result; this affects Venezuela's government and voters.
- It demands full voting results and the release of political prisoners.
- It asks the European Union to prepare renewed sanctions and back international court investigations.
